name: Aeva
selection_rationale: Aeva’s Eve sensing technology is integrated into a SICK sensor product described in a launch announcement.
evidence_scope: Aeva’s product announcement describes Eve sensing integrated into a SICK sensor.

name: Astribot

evidence_scope: The Lumo-1 paper describes S1 learning and its physical pick-and-place test conditions.

evidence_scope: Joint university research reports physical dual-arm assembly; completed steps and completed products use distinct success measures.

name: BeyondHoneycomb

evidence_scope: The official pilot account describes a road shuttle at FIX 2025; the 500-vehicle figure is an expansion plan.
